writtenTo: The post-exilic community in Judah (around 430 BC)
importantNotes: Malachi is the bridge between the OT and NT — the last prophetic voice before 400 years of silence.
The promise of Elijah (4:5) is fulfilled in John the Baptist (Matt 11:14).
The tithing passage (3:8-10) is the only place God says 'test me.'
'I the LORD do not change' (3:6) — God's character is the ground of Israel's survival.
The 'sun of righteousness with healing in its wings' (4:2) — a beautiful messianic image.

chapters.1: God declares His love for Israel; He rebukes the priests for offering defective sacrifices.
chapters.2: Warning to unfaithful priests; condemnation of divorce and faithlessness.
chapters.3: The Lord's messenger will prepare the way; 'Will a man rob God?' — the call to tithe faithfully.
chapters.4: The day of the LORD is coming; the sun of righteousness; Elijah will come before that day.
